Verify and inspect this checkout

From the repository root, this standard checksum command verifies the 233 byte-preserved source files against the import record:

sha256sum -c provenance/imported_originals.sha256

A successful result verifies byte identity. It does not establish that a geometry build, solver, software test, or physical experiment has run. New import notes and index files are separate from the original P11 package manifest.

Recover the complete issued package

Download N2_Selected_Hardpoint_Project.zip using the original-download link above. Verify its SHA-256 before extraction:

sha256sum N2_Selected_Hardpoint_Project.zip

Expected result:

757ef6a4fd6e74e8db6c20262298813dc0fc24d3fdce087c54abfdfe1772d65b

Extract into a new separate directory, preserving the N2_Selected_Hardpoint_Project/ archive root. The complete extraction includes the raw FEA files and website_source/dist/ that are omitted from Git. It also includes the original PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json with all 474 other members. Do not replace issued geometry or results merely to satisfy a checksum.

The original analysis reproduction instructions apply from that extracted package root. In particular, analysis/verify_package.py and analysis/reproduce.py --verify-only check archived raw outputs; a partial Git checkout is expected to report those files missing. The 11 frozen analysis inputs, including the replay wrapper and exact final solver, are already in Git. Future replay should use the supplied remapping wrapper rather than invoking historical configuration paths directly.

Full replay is optional and requires the original pinned environment and meaningful compute. It was not performed for this import. The frozen implementation is suitable for current replay, but historical executing-code provenance is incomplete; archive hash consistency is not proof of bit-identical historical numerical reruns. Reproducibility boundary

Website and editable exports

For the exact issued static website, use the original archive's website_source/dist/. For further development, use the committed website source instructions, application, build script and lockfile. The unchanged builder writes generated data/, dist/, a project snapshot and license outputs; review changes if rebuilding. No dependencies were installed and no build or deployment was performed during this import.

The supplemental package_link.json supplies the now-known saved ZIP link to that builder. It was not a member of the original ZIP. All original files remain unchanged. Import scope note

Use the CAD README for regenerating exports into a new output directory. The current checked-in STEP/STL files are the issued source exports; integrity validation did not regenerate or alter them. Preserve source/version identity when changing geometry so old analysis is not silently attached to a changed part.
